description: Memo rules for regionizer-sim memo (research D15, FR-032). Each value names the sweep folder it reads (<results>/<sweep>/sweep.json), the metric it reads from each run's summary.json (contracts/run-output.md), the population.total every run must have, and its margins and thresholds. Rows read at the constitution's 2,000-player continent cap, except section size, which reads the issue's 5,000-entity stress bound that the bookkeeping budget is set at. Merge rates count real merges; absorptions are reported separately. Interaction ranges and closing speeds are placeholders until game design supplies real values (spec Assumptions); closing speeds are twice each class's default speed ceiling (7, 30 and 120 m/s).

values.title: Claim radius, infantry
values.description: Baseline at 2,000 players with the infantry claim radius swept. Collapse is the smallest radius whose mean over seeds of the p50 fused-fight count is at least 1. The recommendation is the largest radius at least one sweep step below collapse and at or above the analytic floor; if the floor is above it, the row is flagged as a conflict. The region-count and largest-share curves are recorded next to it.

values.title: Claim radius, ground vehicle
values.description: Baseline at 2,000 players with the ground-vehicle claim radius swept. Collapse is the smallest radius whose mean over seeds of the p50 fused-fight count is at least 1. The recommendation is the largest radius at least one sweep step below collapse and at or above the analytic floor; if the floor is above it, the row is flagged as a conflict. The region-count and largest-share curves are recorded next to it.

values.title: Claim radius, aircraft
values.description: Baseline at 2,000 players with the aircraft claim radius swept. Collapse is the smallest radius whose mean over seeds of the p50 fused-fight count is at least 1. The recommendation is the largest radius at least one sweep step below collapse and at or above the analytic floor (two aircraft closing at 240 m/s at 30 Hz: the range plus 8 m); if the floor is above it, the row is flagged as a conflict. The region-count and largest-share curves are recorded next to it.

values.title: Section size
values.description: Baseline (sweep section-size) and One base (sweep section-size-onebase) at 5,000 entities, the stress bound the bookkeeping budget is set at, with the section size swept; each sweep is a series. The smallest size whose bookkeeping p99 is within the 1 ms budget (an estimate until measured) in every seed of both scenarios.

values.title: Claim anchoring
values.description: Baseline at 2,000 players in both anchoring modes at equal bookkeeping cost. The mode with the lower fusion-event rate (fusions per second, every causing class summed). Fusions are a fight reading, so this row reads the constitution's continent cap like the claim-radius rows.

values.title: Minimum base spacing
values.description: Spacing at 2,000 players with the base spacing swept. The smallest spacing whose oversized-fusion ticks are under 1% of ticks in every seed, plus a 100 m sprawl margin (a placeholder until fight sprawl is measured). The fused-fight-pairs, region-count and largest-share curves are recorded next to it.

values.title: Lane bridging limit
values.description: Lane traffic at 2,000 players with the traveller count swept. The largest traffic level whose bridging (fight-fusion) ticks are under 1% of ticks in every seed. The lane-traffic sweep sets metrics.targetFightSize below the two fights' combined player count, so an oversized-fusion tick is a tick on which the fights are fused.

values.title: Split damping
values.description: Migration at 2,000 players with N_min, p_dead and T_min swept. The lowest merge-plus-split rate (per second, every causing class summed) among cells whose split latency p99 is under 5 s (150 ticks at 30 Hz) in every seed. Merges are real merges: absorptions of entity-less regions are not in the rate.

values.title: Air layer
values.description: Air traffic at 2,000 players with and without the air layer. Adopt only if aircraft-caused merges (real merges, not absorptions) drop by at least 25% with no rise in fusion events.

values.title: Target fight size
values.description: Baseline at 2,000 players at the chosen values. The p99 of the largest region's player count, as a reading for the Phase 1 sweep; open decision 2 is set by load tests.
